cases.expectation: All source mechanisms are addressable; import complete and two represented transcription regions do not permit execution.
cases.basis: IG-1A criteria 1, 3, 4; IG-DATA-MODEL: Collections, Reviews and readiness; IG-MECHANICS-PROFILES.

cases.expectation: The retired concept is in the store but is not selected. A historical mention may resolve it.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Identity and record envelope, historical versus active resolution.

cases.expectation: Incomplete review basis cannot establish current freshness.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Reviews and readiness, incomplete basis implies unknown.

cases.expectation: Same stable aspect ID, changed meaning and revision: old scoped acceptance is stale.
cases.basis: IG-WGU-ARCHITECTURE: Acceptance is never inherited by a changed aspect.

cases.expectation: An exact source basis is no longer selected; review becomes stale even with unchanged target.
cases.basis: IG-WGU-ARCHITECTURE: Review bases pin evidence, profile and dependencies.

cases.expectation: Unknown unit needs a null value, reason and a gap.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Knowledge and representation.

cases.expectation: Container hash cannot conceal a stale aspect hash.
cases.basis: IG-1A ID and revision hash criterion; stable aspect content integrity.

cases.expectation: A model may observe but cannot grant semantic acceptance.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Only an authorized human grants semantic acceptance.

cases.expectation: A stored historical revision does not activate its identity.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: References used as active rules resolve only in the selected snapshot.

cases.expectation: Exact historical references must resolve in the supplied immutable store.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Historical review and supersession references resolve in immutable revision store.

cases.expectation: Only one revision per identity may be selected.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: A snapshot selects at most one revision per ID.

cases.expectation: The revision store cannot contain a duplicate identity/revision.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Validate identity/revision uniqueness.

cases.expectation: A normative opaque effect cannot be labelled formal.
cases.basis: IG-LEGAL-ACTIONS: Opaque meaning affecting effect blocks executable readiness.

cases.expectation: The source contract cannot claim executable readiness, including when import is complete.
cases.basis: IG-1A: Source-level opaque is accepted without granting execution.

cases.expectation: Condition/effect composition must select the correctly typed stable aspects.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Shared subject ID does not bind conditions to effects.

cases.expectation: A note must address an existing axis or cell.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Validate table notes/axes; IG-MECHANICS-PROFILES: note scopes.

cases.expectation: Known is an evidenced proposal; an empty evidence list does not establish it.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Knowledge states.

cases.expectation: A concept cannot resolve as a source record.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Validate typed references.

cases.expectation: Origin locators are relative safe paths, never traversal.
cases.basis: IG-WGU-ARCHITECTURE: safe paths and path escapes.

cases.expectation: One persisted origin key cannot silently rematch to multiple identities.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: anonymous identities use persisted registry; ambiguous rematches are conflicts.

cases.expectation: A gap cannot count as represented content.
cases.basis: IG-WGU-ARCHITECTURE: Gaps never count as represented content.

cases.expectation: Source graphs may be cyclic. Missing termination blocks formalization/execution, not source storage.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: rule graphs may contain cycles; procedures need termination rules.

cases.expectation: An unresolved compatibility decision is preserved as unknown, never newer-wins.
cases.basis: IG-WGU-ARCHITECTURE: exact editions and no universal precedence.

cases.expectation: Exception points from modifying clause in a separate section to the base clause; editorial parent is not a dependency.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Exception/modification direction and cross-chapter tests.

cases.expectation: Overlapping inventory regions cannot both enter the transcription denominator.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Validate coverage denominators; no overlapping context in denominator.

cases.expectation: A context-only entry does not add the same region to the denominator.
cases.basis: IG-DATA-MODEL: Do not add overlapping context regions to denominator.
